label: PF Backlog 54
title: Wiring gaps (backend): memory_api, ports single-writer, knowledge-graph persist, on_complete, intent_router
body: 1) core/memory_api.py is probe-only (reachable via pipeline_capabilities string, never exercised) -> wire or retire its surface. 2) ports: core/port_config.update_ports_from_config is effectively dead; runtime writer is pipeline_executor._derive_ports -> single writer. 3) core/phase3_advanced knowledge graph is in-memory only (graph_file assigned, never saved) -> persist or declare ephemeral. 4) pipeline-definition.json on_complete is never executed -> remove or implement. 5) core/intent_router.py is header-marked DEPRECATED yet sits on the live intake path -> un-deprecate or replace. Refs: core/pipeline_capabilities.py:177, core/port_config.py:1121, core/phase3_advanced.py:204, pipeline-definition.json, core/intent_router.py:1.
